zh.title: 秋天的论坛季📒｜AI 时代的金融科技，我听到了什么
zh.text:
最近连着跑了好几场论坛和讲座🎤
从「Future of FinTech in the Age of AI」圆桌，到 TEDx 现场，再到全球论坛的背景板打卡📸
每一场都记满了笔记，越听越确定自己想往金融科技走✨
#会议论坛 #金融科技 #AI #新加坡生活

en.title: Forum season📒 | What I learned about FinTech in the age of AI
en.text:
Back-to-back forums and talks lately🎤
From the “Future of FinTech in the Age of AI” panel to a TEDx event and a global-forum backdrop📸
Notebook full — and more sure than ever that FinTech is where I want to be✨
#Forums #FinTech #AI #SingaporeLife

zh.title: 招聘会打卡🤝｜和业界前辈聊了一下午
zh.text:
穿上白衬衫去逛招聘会👔
一个摊位一个摊位地问，认识了好多很 nice 的人☕️
秋招冲鸭，每一次交流都是在攒经验💪
#招聘会 #秋招 #求职日记 #networking

en.title: Career-fair day🤝 | an afternoon of great conversations
en.text:
White shirt on and off to the career fair👔
Booth after booth, met so many kind people☕️
Recruiting season — every chat is experience earned💪
#CareerFair #Recruiting #JobHunt #Networking

zh.title: 我的宝藏小伙伴们💛｜合影存档
zh.text:
和小伙伴们的合影攒了一相册📷
课室里、商场里、夜晚的海边，一起比耶的样子都好可爱✌️
有你们在，异国的日子一点都不孤单🥹
#小伙伴 #留学生活 #友情 #新加坡

en.title: My treasure friends💛 | photo archive
en.text:
A whole album of group shots with friends📷
In class, at the mall, by the water at night — peace signs everywhere✌️
With you around, life abroad never feels lonely🥹
#Friends #StudyAbroad #Friendship #Singapore

zh.title: 风景摄影🏞️｜把看过的山川湖海存进相册
zh.text:
抬头是峡谷里漏下的一线蓝天，低头是奔涌的河水🌊
湖边吹风，城市里也能等到一颗橘子落日🌅
相机里的风景，是我给自己的充电站🔋
#风景摄影 #旅行 #手机摄影 #治愈系

en.title: Scenery📸🏞️ | saving the views I've collected
en.text:
A slice of blue sky through the canyon walls, a rushing river below🌊
A breezy lakeside, and an orange sunset even in the city🌅
These views are my recharge station🔋
#Landscape #Travel #PhonePhotography #Healing

zh.title: City Walk 出行记🚶‍♀️｜海湾边的城市天际线
zh.text:
开完会顺路去海边走走🌆
高楼、步道、海风，随手一拍都是大片🫶
今天的穿搭也很满意，记录一下👗
#citywalk #出行 #今日穿搭 #城市天际线

en.title: City walk🚶‍♀️ | skyline by the bay
en.text:
A stroll by the water after a busy day🌆
Towers, boardwalks, sea breeze — every snap looks like a postcard🫶
Happy with today's outfit too👗
#CityWalk #OOTD #Skyline #Outing

zh.title: 和小动物的偶遇🐒｜绿意满满的一天
zh.text:
钻进热带雨林，近距离见到了环尾狐猴😍
满眼都是绿色，空气里都是树叶的味道🌿
还有路上遇到的猫猫，乖乖让我拍了一张🐱
#小动物 #自然 #雨林 #猫猫

en.title: Meeting little animals🐒 | a day full of green
en.text:
Into the rainforest and face to face with a ring-tailed lemur😍
Green everywhere, air smelling of leaves🌿
Plus a kitty on the way who posed nicely for me🐱
#Animals #Nature #Rainforest #Cats

zh.title: 今日份运动打卡💪｜流汗的感觉真好
zh.text:
力量训练练背，一组一组慢慢加📈
舞蹈室里也来一张镜子自拍🪞
坚持运动，是给自己最好的礼物✨
#健身 #自律 #运动打卡 #健身女孩

en.title: Workout check-in💪 | nothing beats a good sweat
en.text:
Back day at the gym, adding weight set by set📈
And a mirror selfie in the dance studio🪞
Staying active is the best gift to myself✨
#Fitness #Discipline #Workout #GymGirl

zh.title: 手作微缩小屋🏠｜一点点拼出来的小世界
zh.text:
迷你餐桌、小蛋糕、小厨房，全都是一点点做出来的🧁
做手作的时候特别安静，很解压🧩
成品出来的那一刻超有成就感！
#手作 #微缩模型 #解压 #DIY

en.title: Handmade miniature room🏠 | a tiny world, piece by piece
en.text:
A mini dining table, tiny cakes and a little kitchen — all built bit by bit🧁
Crafting is so quiet and relaxing🧩
Seeing it finished felt amazing!
#Handmade #Miniature #DIY #Relaxing

zh.title: 实习回忆录💼｜从签到台到分组讨论
zh.text:
平安银行财富管理论坛，签到台前和同事合影📸
保诚香港项目里，拿着 iPad 主持分组讨论🎤
每一段实习都让我更懂金融，也更懂自己✨
#实习 #职场 #金融 #成长

en.title: Internship memories💼 | from check-in desk to group discussion
en.text:
At the check-in desk of the Ping An Bank wealth-management forum with a colleague📸
Hosting a group discussion with an iPad on the Prudential Hong Kong program🎤
Each internship taught me more about finance — and about myself✨
#Internship #Work #Finance #Growth

zh.title: 写春联🧧｜一笔一画的年味
zh.text:
和朋友一起铺开红纸、研好墨🖌️
一笔一画写下新年的祝福，年味一下就来了🏮
#写春联 #书法 #新年 #传统文化

en.title: Writing Spring Festival couplets🧧 | New Year, stroke by stroke
en.text:
Red paper laid out, ink ready🖌️
Writing New Year wishes stroke by stroke — instant festive vibes🏮
#Calligraphy #ChineseNewYear #Tradition #Couplets
